verdict.rationale: The evidence shows SolidJS works with TypeScript: it says it is built on TypeScript, offers a TS starter template and documents tsconfig JSX settings. Nothing in the pack states which TypeScript versions are officially supported, or gives a compatibility policy. The only version-support statement covers server runtimes (Node LTS, Deno, Cloudflare Workers), which is a different axis and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As a developer, I know which TypeScript versions the framework officially supports so I can avoid compatibility breaks when upgrading either one
